summary: Bilateral BGP sessions between exchange participants have long been the norm, but the overhead of managing many of them has made route servers popular. This informational document describes operational considerations for running and using route servers at Internet Exchange Points. It complements the route server specification.

eli5.summary: If one post office passes mail between many neighbors, someone must run it well. This is advice for people who run or use that post office at an internet exchange point.

questions: how to operate an ixp route server
